# [Baseline] - WIN - D - Windows Hello Passkey PIN Complexity Numeric

Explicitly sets the numeric PIN for the Windows Hello for Business passkey: digits required, letters and special characters blocked.

| | |
|---|---|
| Platform | Windows |
| Scope | Device (D) — assign to device groups |
| Type | Settings Catalog |
| Assignment | — |
| checkId | `INTUNE-BASE-213-DWindowsHelloPasskeyPINComplexityNumeric` |
| Source | Own choice, PassportForWork CSP — Policies/PINComplexity |
| File | [`Baseline_WIN_D_Windows_Hello_Passkey_PIN_Complexity_Numeric.json`](Baseline_WIN_D_Windows_Hello_Passkey_PIN_Complexity_Numeric.json) |

> This is also the behaviour of Windows without a policy. Setting it explicitly makes it auditable — 'not configured' and 'set to the default' look the same in a tenant export — and it survives a change of default by Microsoft.
